name: Takemizu
source:
One-eyed master of the Takemizu dojo, the most popular branch of Chizuru's sword school. Chizuru thinks of him like an uncle.

[spoiler]Staged fake Kurotengu attacks so he could sell bodyguard work.[/spoiler]
